test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

To reduce to a shorter form intended to stand for the whole
solution:
The correct answer is "**abbreviate**". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abbreviate** means to make a **word or phrase shorter**.

 
 
• **Example**: *WHO is the **abbreviated** form of the World Health Organisation*. 
 
 
 
• Therefore, "abbreviate" means to reduce to a shorter form intended to stand for the whole. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shrink** - to reduce in size.

 
 
• **Example:** *Washing has **shrunk** my shirt. *
 
 
 
• **Protract** - prolong.
 
 
• **Example: ***Tom is **protracting** to make a decision.*
 
 
 
• **Extend** - lengthen something.
 
 
• **Example:*** Ron wants to **extend** his library membership. *
